purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.
post_audit_holds: Claude and Grok each timed out, so external review absence remains visible and confidence remains medium.
WM-LIV-011 parentage remains a reference pending biological boundary review.
Species, pangenome, mitochondrial, repeat, copy-number, structural, somatic, cytogenetic and clinical profiles require specialist review.
Moving, immature and living standards require exact production release pins and conformance tests.
Person or specimen linkage requires consent, purpose, permitted-use, jurisdiction, minimum-disclosure, retention and audit controls.
No clinical significance, functional effect, disease association or treatment decision is inferred from molecular definition.
audit_findings: The aggregate boundary is defensible only with a mandatory sequence, variant or combined-package discriminator.
Sequence content, collection, location, molecular variation, expression, archive accession, call, genotype, consequence and clinical interpretation retain distinct identities.
Molecular variation identity pins reference sequence, accession version or digest, coordinate convention, defining state and normalization algorithm.
Coordinate base, interval boundaries, strand, orientation, circularity, imprecision and multi-allelic decomposition are explicit rather than inferred.
Assembly projection and lift-over remain source-qualified candidate mappings and never silently rewrite identity.
Observed calls and experimental effects remain separate from computational predictions and condition-specific classifications.
Lifecycle changes preserve prior identifiers, source evidence, successors and external references without last-write-wins.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
